result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main problem found is a filter/content mismatch: the 'Pizza' category chip is shown as selected, but the displayed restaurants are mostly non-pizza venues (poké, burgers, ramen), suggesting the filter is not actually applied.

issues.description: The 'Pizza' filter chip is visually active (dark/selected state), but the content below does not reflect a pizza-only filter — 'Fastest near you' shows Green Bowl Poké and Smash Bros Burgers, and 'Popular right now' leads with Tokumaru Ramen Bar (tagged 'Ramen').
issues.suggestion: Either apply the pizza filter to all sections when the chip is selected, or reset the chip to 'All' so the selected state matches the displayed content.

issues.description: Redundant '€0 delivery' information on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card — it appears both as a badge on the image and again in the metadata line below the title.
issues.suggestion: Show the free-delivery indicator only once (e.g., keep the badge and omit it from the metadata line) to reduce visual clutter.
